#3 Axial Skyrmions
- Note that this reflection changes the sign of only one of the pion fields and so their definition of the relative phase differs by an addition of π in comparison with that of refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three of the pion fields.
- The definition used in this paper makes for a more natural comparison with the similar situation for monopoles.
- The profile function is zero at a radius s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), so the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion are patched together in a continuous way, with the fields set to the vacuum outside each of the cores.
- In addition to the initial conditions using the simple ansatz (3.7), more sophisticated initial conditions were also used based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
